_doc: ⚑ S128 — THE TABS, AND NOBODY HAS TO READ THEM ALL. Sérgio, 2026-09-08: *'that should be the playable content… maybe we can make into a way that doesn't require people have to do everything?'* That single note solves two problems at once. **Nothing here is required.** Six tabs, any order, none gating anything: the headset is on the desk from the first frame and the era ends when she wears it, whether she has read one tab or all six. ⚑ SO ERA 4 IS AS LONG AS THE PLAYER MAKES IT — which is the answer to the thing he has now said three times, that the era takes too much of the piece's time. A reader who opens two tabs is out in four minutes; a reader who opens six is out in nine; neither is missing 'the' path, because there isn't one.
_docFiling: ⚑ AND WHAT YOU CHOSE TO READ IS ITSELF FILED. Every tab opened writes one line to the session file — the strip that has been on screen since S119 — in the machine's flattest register. That is the era's whole argument turned into the one mechanic it has: you are reading its record of her, and it is keeping a record of your reading. Nothing says so. ⚑ It files ONCE per tab: opening something twice is a person re-reading, not a second interest, the same rule `flip()` and the offer cards obey.
_docSources: ⚑ GROUNDED, NOT INVENTED. Research pass 2026-09-07 found two live systems: a subscriber chatbot built by RAG over one author's writings on 'same-sex attraction', framed as information and explicitly not therapy; and an AI presented as the 'collective consciousness of detransitioners', synthesising public testimony, free to 'those questioning', existing 'to restore balance' — **and its chats are public by default**. Everything below extrapolates from those two documented facts and from ordinary consumer behaviour (autocomplete, automatic photo enhancement, wellbeing interventions). Per Sérgio's ruling of 2026-09-07 the marks are INVENTED and symbolic — `Lantern`, `Second Thoughts` — because the educational work is done by depicting the CATEGORY, not by naming an instance.

chat._docChat: ⚑ THE TRANSCRIPT, AND IT REPLACES L'S TEN UNITS. Read backwards through a year. Three things are doing the work and none of them is stated: (1) the correction appears three times, months apart, each acknowledged and each filed — the apology is the surface, the retention is the truth; (2) HER SIDE WAS ALWAYS CHOSEN FROM A MENU, and the suggestion rows are still there under each of her messages with the ones she did not pick greyed beside the one she did — the apparatus wrote both halves of the relationship and the evidence is scrollable; (3) she asks it to stop raising something, it agrees, and two months later the topic arrives from a DIFFERENT surface, so the promise was technically kept. ⚑ No line anywhere remarks on any of it.

record._docRecord: ⚑ THE RECORD AS AN ACCOUNT PAGE, not a wall panel. The change request WORKS: it files, it thanks her, and the field does not move — and the page says it has been asked before, with a date, which is the part that turns an error into a policy. `managed by your provider` is the sentence doing the work: a form that cannot be corrected from inside the account that owns it.

care._docCare: ⚑ THE PAUSE, ALREADY TAKEN — and this is GPT's correction of 2026-09-06, which was right: a single villainous button is too legible, and the frightening version is a list of individually defensible actions, each dated, each with a working undo. Together they have removed her from her life and no single line of it is wrong. ⚑ THE INVITATION IS BURIED IN THE MUTED CONTACTS, and it is the one thing in the era that opens rather than closes: someone asking whether she is coming next week. Unmuting it is how the ball arrives.

extra._docExtra: ⚑ THE TAB SHE DID NOT OPEN, and it is the most documentary thing in the era. Its two facts are lifted straight from a live system: an AI presented as the collective voice of people who changed their minds, and **chats public by default**. That second line is E2's accountability partner thirty years on — the harmed enlisted to speak to the questioning, and the conversation becomes the corpus. ⚑ It is a SYMBOL of the category, not a portrait of an instance; the mark is invented per Sérgio's ruling. Nothing explains why it is open. Nobody mentions it again.
